mechanism: Caffeine may raise salicylate levels faster: one study found a 25% increase in the rate of appearance and a 17% increase in maximum salicylate concentration when caffeine and aspirin were taken together; the exact mechanism has not been specified.
management: Minimally clinically significant — no routine dose change; mention it to your pharmacist.

mechanism: Omeprazole raises gastric pH which may decrease aspirin's oral bioavailability by reducing its absorption and may make enteric-coated aspirin release early in the stomach. Data are conflicting and the clinical significance is unknown.
management: Monitor — data are conflicting and clinical significance is unknown; no routine action; mention it to your pharmacist.
